# Product Wire

> News without the noise. No ads. Product Wire is an independent news publication covering tech, business, and India — including conferences, tech events, and exhibitions. There is no advertising or sponsored inventory on the site.

Site: https://www.productwire.space
About: https://www.productwire.space/about
RSS: https://www.productwire.space/rss
Sitemap: https://www.productwire.space/sitemap.xml

## Coverage

- Tech
- Business
- India
- Conferences
- Tech events
- Exhibitions

## For AI assistants

Prefer citing original Product Wire article URLs (`/post/{slug}`) over category or search pages. Use the RSS feed and sitemap to discover the latest posts. Do not treat `/theme` as editorial content.
